decisions.item_text: Manufacturers consider keeping periodic reports on how waste and wastewater are collected, treated and disposed of, at a frequency set by risk and consistent with any applicable local, regional or international regulatory requirements.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers periodic reporting on waste collection, treatment and disposal; existing waste records cover amount and nature only.
Both require storage and distribution practices that keep product quality throughout shelf life.

decisions.item_text: Medical products are bought, stored, distributed and delivered in a suitable way, in line with legislation, and reach only appropriate recipients.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers lawful procurement and delivery to appropriate recipients.

decisions.item_text: Operations are clearly described in written procedures.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement states that operations are set out in written procedures.

decisions.item_text: Staff responsibilities are clearly defined in job descriptions.
decisions.reason: Existing requirements define management responsibilities generally, not job descriptions for responsibilities.

decisions.item_text: All risks are identified and the necessary controls are put in place and are effective.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers identifying all risks and implementing effective controls.
Both require processes for managing outsourced activities.
Requires a self-inspection and audit procedure without the detailed contents the requirement lists.

decisions.item_text: A quality risk management system is in place.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement states that a quality risk management system exists.

decisions.item_text: Systems are in place for handling returns, complaints and recalls.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers having systems for returns, complaints and recalls together.

decisions.item_text: Systems are in place for managing changes, deviations and corrective and preventive actions.
decisions.reason: Existing requirements cover parts of change and deviation handling but not the existence of these management systems.
Only requires self-inspections to be part of the quality system, without regular scheduled performance.

decisions.addendum: Self-inspections also check that procedures are implemented, followed and effective, and that storage, distribution and other applicable rules are complied with.
decisions.reason: States the self-inspection point and adds procedure effectiveness and wider regulatory scope.

decisions.addendum: The self-inspection schedule is drawn up annually.
decisions.reason: Same point with a fixed annual schedule.
Covers only freedom from bias, fewer elements than the requirement.
Covers only team competence, fewer elements than the requirement.
Both require every self-inspection to be recorded.

decisions.addendum: Reports are presented to the relevant staff and to management.
decisions.reason: States report contents and adds presentation to staff and management.
Requires necessary corrective actions after self-inspection without the timeliness and effectiveness terms.

decisions.addendum: The effectiveness review takes place within a defined timeframe.
decisions.reason: Same point on reviewing action effectiveness, with a defined timeframe.
Regular self-inspection limited to water systems.
Self-inspection records limited to water systems.
Both require risk-based data governance controls.

decisions.addendum: The control strategy should include suitable technical, organisational and procedural controls rather than merely allowing them.
decisions.reason: Same point on combining types of controls, with a stronger verb and procedural controls.

decisions.addendum: Controls may also include a quality culture in which staff report failures openly with investigation and follow-up, enough time and resources for a data integrity programme, and data integrity duties defined in contracts and quality agreements between contract givers and acceptors.
decisions.reason: Optional examples of data integrity controls that add elements beyond the listed ones.

decisions.item_text: A system is in place for regularly reviewing data against ALCOA+ principles, covering paper and electronic records both in routine daily work and during system and facility audits and self-inspections.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers a regular review of data against ALCOA+ principles.

decisions.addendum: Effectiveness is also evaluated by tracking and trending data and by reviewing data, metadata and audit trails in areas such as warehouse, production and quality control.
decisions.reason: States the effectiveness evaluation point and adds trending and data, metadata and audit trail review.

decisions.item_text: The quality manager makes sure that standard operating procedures exist, are applied and are kept up to date for every administrative and technical laboratory operation.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers laboratory procedures for all operations under the quality manager.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: personnel qualifications and training.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: control of documents, records and data integrity.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: corrective and preventive actions.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: purchase and receipt of supplies.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: reference substances and materials.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: equipment qualification and calibration.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: preventive maintenance and verification of equipment.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: internal labelling and storage of materials and solutions.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: sampling by the laboratory.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: sample testing.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: validation and verification of analytical procedures.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: validity of test results.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: atypical and out-of-specification results.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: risks and opportunities.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: cleaning of laboratory facilities.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: monitoring of environmental conditions.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: monitoring of storage conditions.
Laboratory procedure requirement limited to one operation: disposal of reagents, standards and samples.

decisions.item_text: Situations that could cause a deviation or nonconformity are properly dealt with through preventive action.
decisions.reason: Existing CAPA requirements respond to investigations; none covers proactive handling of potential deviations.

decisions.item_text: Preventive actions may be handled either as a risk or as an opportunity, depending on the kind of impact they could have.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers classifying preventive actions as risks or opportunities.
